QuestInfo.name: The First Mission
QuestInfo.0: Meet #b#p1101002##k, the great tactician of #p1101000#, and ask what your next step should be.
QuestInfo.1:
Go find 10 Boogies in #b#m130000200##k.

1. Press the hotkey Q to open the quest info window.
2. Click on the Navigation button. 
3. Click on the shining area in the World Map UI and select it as your destination.
4. Press the Enable Navigation button on the World Map UI.
5. You can follow the direction of the red arrow on top of your head to find 10 Boogies.
QuestInfo.2:
You met 10 Boogies at the Crossroads of Ereve.
Ask 10 Boogies what kind of mission you have to do.

0.0: The others have most likely been too forgiving of your shortcomings, but I will be honest with you. You will not be able to complete the missions I require.
0.1: However, I never waste a valuable asset. You will assist the more senior members until you are ready to stand on your own. Go find #b10 Boogies#k at the #bCrossroads of Ereve#k, and do whatever she requires.

yes.0: Press the Q key to open your quest info window. Select your destination and press the Enable Navigation button to be guided to 10 Boogies.

no.0: Are you going to just stand there dumbfounded? You are a Knight-in-Training. Act like it.

npc.0: Go find #b10 Boogies#k at the #bCrossroads of Ereve#k, and do whatever she requires. Press the Q key to open your quest info window. Select your destination and press the Enable Navigation button to be guided to 10 Boogies.
